pages.text: The Fluid Stabilizer scans source fluid blocks within its configured range and matches them against the JDT FluidDrop recipes using the item in the catalyst slot.$(br2)$(li)Converts up to 1 source fluid block per operation.$(li)Consumes 1 catalyst per successful conversion.$(li)Creative Upgrade waives both FE and catalyst consumption.$(li)Filter slots use fluid buckets as filter items.$(li)Supports redstone control, Range Upgrade, Filter Upgrade, Overclock, Underclock, and Capacity Upgrades.$(br2)For example, placing JDT's Polymorph Catalyst converts water sources to polymorph fluid; placing JDTE's Time Fluid Catalyst converts water sources to time fluid.
Does not require FE and only consumes catalysts. Longer operation interval (40 ticks).
Requires both FE and catalysts. Operation interval is 20 ticks, with FE consumption scaling with configured range.
An extended version of the Advanced Fluid Stabilizer with 8 upgrade slots. Obtained by right-clicking an Advanced Fluid Stabilizer with an Extended Upgrade.
